0022600092.text: Both the Phoenix Suns and the Portland Trail Blazers are opening their 2026-27 seasons, so this is the Suns' first game of the season. Mark Williams is out after shoulder surgery, and Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (hip soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. For Portland, Shaedon Sharpe is out after knee surgery, while Chris Youngblood (calf soreness), Jrue Holiday (hand soreness), and Micah Potter (illness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Suns won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, but they lost their most recent meeting 92-77 in Phoenix on February 22, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
